messages.context: Agnes 介绍自己管理的女巫年商店
messages.raw: §fI manage the §5Year of the Witch Shop§f, where you can exchange §6ingredients§f from the event for rewards.
messages.text: I manage the Year of the Witch Shop, where you can exchange ingredients from the event for rewards.
messages.gloss: Year of the Witch 是每 12 个 SkyBlock 年出现一次的活动；ingredients 是击杀各类怪物掉落的活动材料。
messages.zh: 我经营着女巫年商店，你可以用活动中获得的材料兑换奖励。

messages.context: Agnes 引导玩家向附近的 Alcina 了解材料
messages.raw: §fTalk to §dAlcina§f nearby if you'd like to learn how to gather §6ingredients§f, as well as what they're used for!
messages.text: Talk to Alcina nearby if you'd like to learn how to gather ingredients, as well as what they're used for!
messages.gloss: Alcina 是 NPC 人名，保留英文。
messages.zh: 去问问附近的 Alcina，就能了解如何收集材料，以及它们有何用途!
